project_type: Static website - Vite + vanilla JS + Three.js + GSAP scrollytelling
build_system: Vite 8.x for dev server and production bundling. Base path: /species-on-screen/
test_framework: None - visual prototype, validation is build success
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install, 2. Run npm run build, 3. Verify dist/ directory has index.html and species/*.html pages, 4. Verify public/data/*.json files are populated with TMDB results
snapshot_or_generated_files: public/data/*.json files are generated by scripts/fetch-tmdb-data.js and SHOULD be checked in (they are static data that ships with the site). dist/ is NOT checked in.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access, can install npm packages and call TMDB API. Node.js v22.22.3 available. Target deployment: GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. This is a fresh project on feat/multi-species-tmdb branch.
key_patterns: Vite multi-page app via rollupOptions.input. index.html at root. src/ for JS/CSS. public/ for static assets (JSON data, images). Three.js globe in src/globe.js with lazy loading via IntersectionObserver. GSAP ScrollTrigger for scroll-driven animations. Glass-card/glass-panel CSS components. Pastel ecological color palette (--color-forest, --color-water, --color-savanna, --color-mist, --color-ice). No framework - vanilla JS.
directory_structure: / - project root with index.html, vite.config.js, package.json; /src - JavaScript modules and CSS; /public - static assets (will contain /public/data/ for species JSON); /species - individual species HTML pages (new); /scripts - Node.js utility scripts (new); /.github/workflows - GitHub Actions deployment
